caption: The drawing features a single wooden bowl centered on a plain off-white background. The bowl is depicted in a naturalistic style and is viewed from an oblique angle that allows the interior, as well as part of the exterior, to be seen. It has a wide, shallow shape with a rounded rim, and its surface is rendered in shades of brown, suggesting the texture and grain of wood. Darker brown and blackish markings appear inside the bowl, adding depth and tonal variety. The edges and contours of the bowl are clearly defined, while the interior shows subtle shading to indicate its curved, concave form. There are no other objects or elements in the drawing, and the artist's signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Maple Mixing Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
